profiles.name: Endometrial endometrioid carcinoma
profiles.discriminator: Abnormal uterine bleeding; malignant endometrioid glands; POLE/MMRd/p53abn/NSMP modify prognosis and FIGO 2023 staging
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Cervical squamous carcinoma
profiles.discriminator: Persistent oncogenic HPV E6/E7 activity and p16 block staining; stromal invasion distinguishes cancer from HSIL
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Ovarian serous carcinoma, high grade
profiles.discriminator: TP53 abnormality frequent; fallopian fimbrial STIC common precursor; distinguish low-grade MAPK-driven tumors
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Endometriosis
profiles.discriminator: Ectopic endometrial-like tissue, cyclical pain; normal ultrasound does not exclude superficial peritoneal disease
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Uterine leiomyoma
profiles.discriminator: Well-circumscribed whorled benign smooth-muscle nodules; no presumption of inevitable progression to leiomyosarcoma
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Endometrial intraepithelial neoplasia / atypical endometrial hyperplasia
profiles.discriminator: Clonal premalignant gland crowding; exclude concurrent carcinoma before fertility-sparing progestins
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Endometrial serous carcinoma
profiles.discriminator: Often atrophic endometrium with aggressive p53-abnormal high-grade tumor even when superficial
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: HPV-associated endocervical adenocarcinoma
profiles.discriminator: HPV-associated glandular cervical cancer; p16 block/apical mitoses, unlike HPV-independent gastric-type
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma
profiles.discriminator: Endometriosis-associated; ARID1A/PIK3CA; hobnail cells and hyaline cores
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Adult-type ovarian granulosa cell tumor
profiles.discriminator: FOXL2 p.C134W supports tumor class; estrogenic effects and very late recurrence
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Ovarian dysgerminoma
profiles.discriminator: OCT4, SALL4, PLAP, CD117 positive germ-cell neoplasm; generally platinum sensitive
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Adenomyosis
profiles.discriminator: Endometrial glands and stroma in myometrium; heavy painful menses; junctional-zone changes
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
profiles.discriminator: Atypia, mitotic activity and tumor-cell necrosis; imaging cannot categorically exclude malignancy in presumed fibroids
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Complete hydatidiform mole
profiles.discriminator: Often androgenetic diploidy; diffuse trophoblastic hyperplasia, absent villous p57 with positive internal controls
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Gestational choriocarcinoma
profiles.discriminator: Cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast without chorionic villi; marked hCG; early hematogenous metastases
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Cervical high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL/CIN3)
profiles.discriminator: High-grade noninvasive squamous dysplasia; p16 positivity alone does not establish invasion
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending

profiles.name: Ovarian low-grade serous carcinoma
profiles.discriminator: Often KRAS/BRAF/MAPK-driven low-grade nuclei; relative reduced response to standard cytotoxic chemotherapy
profiles.clinical_status: source-anchored education draft; independent gynecologic pathology review pending
